name: Split hero
summary: Headline, supporting copy, and two actions beside a numbered checklist panel. Stacks on phones.
accessibility: Uses a single <h1>. Place it once per page.
The checklist is an ordered list; the number badges are aria-hidden so screen readers don't read each number twice.
Both actions are links with visible focus outlines.

states.name: hover
states.description: The primary action drops to 90% opacity; the secondary action fills with the surface color.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A 2px outline in the focus color on both actions.

props.title: One inbox for every customer question.
props.body: Email, chat, and forms land in the same queue, with the history attached.
